notes.title: Gerty v1.0 - Full release + Rogue mode!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RMl8DIW.gif[/img]

[i][u]NOTE: Due to an internal Unity update, gamepad keybinds might be incorrect. Check your settings![/u][/i]

Greetings mercenaries! Gerty is finally fully released with improvements and a bit of new content to boot!

[h1]Release discount -30%![/h1]
To celebrate our release and the holidays, we're putting Gerty up for a [b]-30% discount[/b]. If you've been waiting for your chance to buy the game, here it is!

[h1]Rogue mode[/h1]
If you've already been playing the game in Early Access and have been itching for an additional challenge, we've got something new for and exciting for you. Introducing: Rogue mode!
[list]
[*]No automatic health regeneration
[*]Randomized & limited item purchases at Forges
[*]Randomized Perk selection
[/list]
Think you're up for the challenge?

[h1]Performance updates[/h1]
We've done several performance updates here and there, which should result in a more smooth gameplay experience. Especially when it comes to [i][b][secret][/b][/i].

Stay tuned
- Gerty Team

notes.title: Changelog: v1.9.1
notes.notes:
[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Last half of World 2 is now playable
[*]Final Boss-fight is now playable
[*]Ending cinematic is now accessible
[*][i][classified][/i] is now accessible
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Arfifacts are now called Data Fragments
[*]Data Fragments can be used to [i][classified][/i]

[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix: v1.8.4
notes.notes:
We've released a small update to address a few possibly gamebreaking issues, in addition to other small improvements.

[h1]Game balance[/h1]
[i]Based on feedback we've gotten from some players, we've made the following changes:[/i]
[list]
[*]Very Easy -difficulty is now even easier
[*]New Advanced Option: Threat spawns can now be disabled on all difficulties
[/list]
[i]These changes should make the game less punishing for those who want a more relaxed experience.[/i]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Co-op: Fixed players respawning inside Obsidian blocks
[*]Fixed enemy spawners appearing inside Obsidian in Survival stages
[*]Fixed Blinker enemies dying during blink
[/list]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Recolored Plant Wormling graphics
[/list]

- Gerty Team

notes.title: Gerty v1.8 update and Weeklong sale
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DrGIOTl.gif[/img]
Welcome to a new world, mercenaries! We have just released a major content update to Gerty along with a [u][b]HUGE 45% SALE[/b][/u] to boot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iw5AjQP.gif[/img]
For those craving for more Gerty content, we're happy to announce that [u][b]World 2 is now playable up to the second Commander[/b][/u] (aka Mini-boss) stage. In other words, the game now includes eleven playable stages, two Commanders and the first world boss, Grongo the Slayer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J6DNiAY.gif[/img]
The first half of World 2 contains a dozen new enemies, more opportunities to level up and try new perks, more Juice to buy items with and new tunes to inspire you to even greater heroics! Provided you can survive the dangers...

Now get out there and fight the alien menace! And be sure to let us know what you think over at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/455100/discussions/]Discussion pages[/url] (and report any bugs or issues)

[i]In addition to new content, this update features the following changes:[/i]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Combat Shield now takes 20% damage from Lava and Acid - previously immune (0%)
[*]Changed enemy blood opacity
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Grongo dropping two Exp Orbs when skipping end cutscene
[*]Fixed Mortar item dealing wrong amount of damage
[*]Fixed Unum's Nano Poison bugging out enemy animations
[*]Fixed Unum's Warp Portal revealing area while player was dead
[*]Fixed Unum becoming visible during stage transition in co-op when using Warp Portal
[/list]

notes.title: Lunar New Year Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kCHNqxP.gif[/img]

Greetings mercenaries! While we're hard at work on World 2 (including some closed testing), we've kept a close eye on the discussion forums and the issues you've all been posting. Here's a list of the fixes and improvements we've pushed out recently:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved and fixed Steam Achievement unlocking
[*]Mouse cursor is now hidden when using Gamepads
[*]Improved 4:3 and 5:4 aspect ratio support
[/list]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Monuments blocking off critical routes
[*]Fixed Combat Shield being visible during stage transitions
[*]Fixed Magnus Punch dealing less damage than intended to terrain
[*]Fixed Shield Booster particle colors in co-op
[/list]

Happy digging and shooting!

notes.title: End of the Year Update
notes.notes:
Season's greetings to all! We've released a small update for both the demo and Early Access versions, mostly focusing on bug fixes.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed players repawning outside the stages in co-op
[*]Fixed Mega Bomber miniboss not being able to reach the player in certain cases
[*]Fixed Panic Button & Pacemaker item related bugs
[/list]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Set default camera zoom to 3 (from 5) - you can change the zoom in the Options at any time
[*]Made the Fog of War slightly brighter
[*]Updated some particle effects
[*]Grongo no longer rewards experience, but drops an Exp Orb instead
[/list]

(Other minor fixes and improvements included as well)

We've also been hard at work on World 2, doing our best to get the first half of it playable, as listed in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/455100/announcements/]roadmap[/url].

Merry Christmas and a happy new year to all!

notes.title: Small update to character aiming behaviour
notes.notes:
We have changed our default character aiming behaviour to be more in suit with other twin-stick shooting games.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XHXVGwg.gif[/img]

Previously while walking, our characters were facing the walking direction and only rotated to aim direction while shooting (on the right). With the new system, the character always faces the aim direction while not digging terrain (on the left).

If you already got used to the previous system, we have added an option to gameplay options to use our previous system.

What do you guys think? Do you prefer the new system or the old system?

notes.title: Release date confirmed: 3rd of December
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to announce that Gerty early access will be publicly available 3rd of December 2018 for PC, MacOS and Linux.

If your hands are already twitching for some rogue-lite action, try downloading the demo and give us feedback about the game in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/455100/discussions/]Discussion page[/url] so that we can make the game even better!
